description: This is a FastAPI backend server implementation for a career path navigator application. It provides endpoints for health checks, role management, progress tracking, graph generation for role transitions, recommendations, and assessments. The file sets up the FastAPI app, database initialization, CORS middleware, and defines all route handlers with their respective logic, including dependency injection for database sessions and internal helper functions.

classes.name: AssessmentIn
classes.description: Input schema for assessing strengths and gaps between roles.

classes.name: AssessmentOut
classes.description: Output schema for the assessment report detailing strengths and gaps.

classes.name: GraphOut
classes.description: Schema for representing the role transition graph with nodes, links, and meta information.

classes.name: RecommendationOut
classes.description: Schema for recommendations related to role-skill pairs.

classes.name: RoleOut
classes.description: Schema representing a list of roles.

classes.name: RoleDetailOut
classes.description: Schema detailing roles including associated skills and recommendations.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint that returns a simple 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all roles available in the system.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific role, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists all progress entries for a given role.

methods.name: ProgressOut set_progress( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates or updates a progress record for a specific role skill.

methods.name: GraphOut get_graph( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Generates a D3-compatible graph of role transition and skill requirements.

methods.name: List[RecommendationOut] get_recommendations( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches recommendations for specific role and skill IDs.

methods.name: AssessmentOut assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Compares two roles to identify strengths and gaps in skills.

methods.name: Optional[Role] _get_role_by_id(repo: RoleRepository, role_id: int)
methods.description: Helper to find a role by ID using cached list of roles.

methods.name: str _sanitize(value: str)
methods.description: Performs basic sanitization on string inputs.
